commands.review_summary:
This PR moves normal-path `session.ended` trajectory recording from inline with `model.completed` into the embedded runner `finally` block, preserves terminal status/error, and flushes afterward.

PR surface: Source -2. Total -2 across 1 file.

Reproducibility: yes. Source inspection shows current main records normal-path `session.ended` inline with the final model events, and the PR head still records it before cleanup rather than at the actual session-end boundary.

target.title: fix(telemetry): record session.ended trajectory event after flush, not inline with model.completed
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #102014 — the `session.ended` trajectory event timestamp equals the last
`model.completed` timestamp, making it impossible to measure actual session
duration vs model compute time.

## Root Cause

`session.ended` was recorded inside the try block immediately after
`model.completed` in the same synchronous execution. Both events called
`new Date().toISOString()` within the same millisecond, producing identical
timestamps.

## Fix

1. Defer `session.ended` from the try block to the finally block
2. Record `session.ended` **before** `flushEmbeddedAttemptTrajectoryRecorder`
   so the final event is included in the drained batch
3. Capture `attemptTrajectoryTerminal.status` alongside `terminalError` and
   use the resolved status (success/error/interrupted) instead of the generic
   cleanup/interrupted/error fallback

## Evidence

### Real Behavior Proof

Trajectory export from a live agent session on this branch:

```
session.started     ts=2026-07-08T06:32:15.759Z  seq=1
model.completed     ts=2026-07-08T06:32:22.698Z  seq=5
session.ended       ts=2026-07-08T06:32:22.717Z  seq=7
```

`session.ended` (22.717, seq=7) is recorded 19ms after `model.completed`
(22.698, seq=5), proving the event is now independent instead of inline.

### Autoreview (claude-sonnet-5)

```
autoreview --mode branch --engine claude --model claude-sonnet-5
→ patch is correct (0.95), no accepted/actionable findings
```

- [x] `oxfmt --check` passes
- [x] `oxlint` passes
- [x] `git diff --check` passes
- [x] autoreview clean (claude-sonnet-5, 0.95)
